This week, **Zeteo** published our 'Start the Steal' special series, detailing
the many, many ways that Donald Trump and his allies are working to rig or
steal this year's midterm elections - and how Democratic officials and
nonprofit organizations are standing up to Trump's scorched-earth attack on
American democracy.

To cap this series, **Mehdi** will moderate a **LIVE Town Hall TODAY** at
**2pm ET / 11am PT / 7pm BST** with **Swin** , who co-authored all four
articles, and **Skye Perryman** , president of Democracy Forward, a legal
nonprofit that routinely fights the Trump administration in court.
